triggers.desc: Markdown editor: a textarea with a formatting toolbar (bold, italic, heading, list, link) and a preview toggle.

….desc: Every other option is passed as a prop to the [QInput](https://quasar.dev/vue-components/input#qinput-api) textarea.

data.desc: The markdown text. Read-only, the rendered markdown is displayed (sanitized with DOMPurify). The toolbar titles come from the `markdown.*` i18n keys.
